instruction.name: xvsrai.w
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift the signed 32-bit elements in `a` by `imm`, store the result to `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsrai.w $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvsrai.w $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvsrai.w $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvsrai.w $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvsrai.w $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvsrai.w $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvsrai.w $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvsrai.w $xr7, $xr15, 1
